scenes.caption: Installing Provenance Wiki on Windows
scenes.say: This video shows you how to install Provenance Wiki on a Windows computer. It takes about ten minutes, and you don't need any technical knowledge. You can pause the video at any time.

scenes.caption: You need: the Setup file, a few test photos, and two API keys
scenes.say: Before you start, you need three things. The Provenance Wiki Setup file. A few photographs of test documents. And two A P I keys: one from Anthropic, and one from Voyage A I. The tester instructions explain where to get them.

scenes.caption: Download the Setup file. If your browser warns you, choose Keep
scenes.say: First, download the Setup file from the shared folder. Your browser may warn that the file isn't commonly downloaded. That's expected for this testing version. Choose Keep, or Download anyway.

scenes.caption: Open your Downloads folder and double-click the Setup file
scenes.say: When the download has finished, open your Downloads folder, and double-click the Setup file.

scenes.caption: “Windows protected your PC”: click More info
scenes.say: Windows may show a blue box that says: Windows protected your PC. This is normal for this testing version. Click More info.

scenes.caption: Then click Run anyway
scenes.say: Then click Run anyway.

scenes.caption: Click “I accept the agreement”, then Next
scenes.say: The installer opens. First, the license. Click I accept the agreement, then click Next.

scenes.caption: Read the note about this testing version, then click Next
scenes.say: Next is a short note about this testing version. Read it, then click Next.

scenes.caption: Keep the suggested folder and click Next
scenes.say: The installer suggests where to put the program. The program is small and doesn't grow, so keep this folder, and click Next.

scenes.caption: Optional: tick “Create a desktop shortcut”, then Next
scenes.say: If you'd like an icon on your desktop, tick Create a desktop shortcut. Then click Next.

scenes.caption: Click Install. No administrator password is needed
scenes.say: Click Install. You won't be asked for an administrator password.

scenes.caption: Leave “Open Provenance Wiki now” ticked and click Finish
scenes.say: When it's done, leave Open Provenance Wiki now ticked, and click Finish.

scenes.caption: Provenance Wiki opens in your web browser, on your own computer
scenes.say: Provenance Wiki opens in your web browser. It runs on your own computer, not on a website. The welcome page has four steps.

scenes.caption: Step 1: Click “Create my archive here”
scenes.say: Step one: where to store your archive. The suggested folder is fine for most people. Click Create my archive here.

scenes.caption: Short on space? Click “Choose another folder” and pick a larger drive
scenes.say: If your C drive is nearly full, click Choose another folder instead, and pick a folder on a larger drive. Avoid folders that sync to the cloud, like OneDrive.

scenes.caption: Your archive is ready
scenes.say: Your archive is now set up. It shows where it's stored, and how much space is free.

scenes.caption: Step 2: Paste your Anthropic key and click Save. Then do the same for Voyage AI
scenes.say: Step two: your A P I keys. Copy your Anthropic key, paste it into the first box, and click Save. Then do the same for your Voyage A I key, in the second box.

scenes.caption: Click “Test connection” to check each key
scenes.say: Each key now shows Saved. Click Test connection to check that it works. Your keys are kept in Windows' secure storage, not in a file.

scenes.caption: Step 3: Read what leaves your computer
scenes.say: Step three explains what information leaves your computer. Please read it before you add any confidential material.

scenes.caption: Step 4: Click “Open photos folder”
scenes.say: Step four: add your photos. Click Open photos folder.

scenes.caption: Copy your photographs into this folder (JPEG, PNG, TIFF or WebP), then close it
scenes.say: A folder window opens. Copy your photographs into it. They can be jay peg, P N G, tiff, or web P files, with one photograph per page. Then close the folder window.

scenes.caption: Click “I’ve added photos: check again”
scenes.say: Back in your browser, click: I've added photos, check again. It shows how many new photographs are ready.

scenes.caption: Don’t forget the Source: where these documents come from (required)
scenes.say: Now fill in the Source: the archive or collection these documents come from. Don't skip this. It's required, and it's saved with every document, so you can cite it later.

scenes.caption: Click “Ingest Photos”. When it’s done, open the Gallery
scenes.say: Click Ingest Photos. Each photograph is read by Anthropic, so this can take a little while. When it's done, open the Gallery to see your documents.

scenes.caption: Find the P icon near the clock (you may need to click ^ first)
scenes.say: A small P icon sits near the clock at the bottom of your screen. You may need to click the small arrow to see it.

scenes.caption: Right-click it to reopen the app, open your photos, or Quit
scenes.say: Right-click it to open Provenance Wiki again, open your photos folder, or quit. Closing the browser tab doesn't stop the app. To stop it, choose Quit.

scenes.caption: Next time, open Provenance Wiki from the Start menu
scenes.say: Next time, open Provenance Wiki from the Start menu, like any other app.

scenes.caption: Something went wrong? Send us a screenshot and a short note
scenes.say: That's it. If anything goes wrong, take a screenshot, and send it to us with a short note. Thank you for testing Provenance Wiki.
